    definition_owner,
    definition_name,
    DATE_FORMAT(reporting_month, 'MMMM yyyy')
        AS reporting_month,
    CAST(revenue AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS value,
    CASE
        WHEN definition_owner = 'Governed'
            THEN 'Certified'
        ELSE 'Conflicting'
    END AS governance_status
FROM databrick_by_databrick.kpi_trust_lab
    .revenue_definition_comparison;

    CAST(

        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS recognized_subscription_revenue

WITH months AS (
  SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS reporting_month
), active_subs AS (
  SELECT
    m.reporting_month,
    s.monthly_recurring_revenue
  FROM months m
  JOIN databrick_by_databrick.kpi_trust_lab.subscriptions s
    ON s.subscription_start_date <= LAST_DAY(m.reporting_month)
    AND (s.churn_date IS NULL OR s.churn_date > LAST_DAY(m.reporting_month))
    AND UPPER(TRIM(s.subscription_status)) <> 'TRIAL'
) SELECT
  reporting_month,
  SUM(monthly_recurring_revenue) * 12 AS revenue
FROM active_subs GROUP BY reporting_month

## Business Problem: Same KPI name. Different business meaning.

The KPI Trust Lab has been hired by Financial Co. to resolve an issue where the July 2026 results have varying figures.

The KPI Trust Lab has found that the variations are as a result of each department of Financial Co. applying a different definition, time basis and source.

Finding: The organization uses the term “revenue” for four different financial concepts. The calculations are not necessarily incorrect, but they are not comparable.
Definitions found: - Finance: Net billed revenue, net of refunds - Sales: Closed-won annual contract value - Product: Annualized run-rate recurring revenue - Governed: Monthly recognized subscription revenue
Recommended enterprise definition:
Recognized subscription revenue: active contracted monthly recurring value attributable to the reporting month, net of allocated refunds. Why this definition?
It aligns revenue to the period in which the subscription service is provided. ACV and ARR should remain available, but they should be labeled as bookings and run-rate measures rather than revenue.

KPI Trust Lab is a data consulting company specializing in modern data platforms and analytics solutions, with a focus on Databricks and other data-related technologies. We help organizations transform complex, fragmented data into reliable, actionable insights by improving data quality, building scalable data pipelines, developing analytics solutions, and connecting technical data systems to business needs. Our goal is to help businesses build trust in their data so they can make faster, more informed decisions.

## One certified definition for each enterprise KPI

Establish one certified enterprise definition for each KPI in Unity Catalog, while retaining departmental measures under precise business names.

Implementation:

1. Define once: Encode certified calculations in Unity Catalog metric views.
2. Reuse consistently: Use the same measures across AI/BI dashboards and Genie.
3. Govern transparently: Document the owner, business rule, time basis, source and certification status.

The objective is not to eliminate departmental metrics. It is to stop different business concepts from being presented under the same KPI name.
Active contracted monthly recurring value, net of refunds allocated to July.
Active paid subscription plus at least one product session in the trailing 60 days.
Qualified July cohort leads that became customers divided by all qualified July cohort leads.

Finding:
Each department interprets “active” differently. Some definitions measure payment, some measure CRM status and others measure product engagement.
Definitions found: - Finance: Customer with a paid invoice in the trailing 90 days - Sales: Customer with an Active or Trial CRM status - Product: Customer with at least three sessions during the month - Governed: Active paid subscription and recent product engagement
Recommended enterprise definition:
Paying and engaged customer: a customer with an active paid subscription and at least one product session during the trailing 60 days. Why this definition:
It combines commercial activity with actual product engagement, reducing the risk of counting expired, trial or non-using customers as active.

Finding:
The departments use different funnel stages, populations and denominators. Therefore, the percentages answer different business questions.
Definitions found: - Sales: Closed-won opportunities divided by closed opportunities - Marketing: MQLs that generated an opportunity divided by all MQLs - Executive: Customers acquired divided by all leads - Governed: Qualified leads becoming customers divided by all qualified leads in the reporting cohort
Recommended enterprise definition:
Qualified lead-to-customer conversion: qualified leads associated with a closed-won opportunity divided by all qualified leads in the reporting cohort. Why this definition:
It evaluates conversion from a consistent point in the funnel while controlling for qualification status and cohort period.
